title: Almanac profile
description: S10: the owner's opinions about ranking (R10). Device owned, local, versioned, never sent anywhere. Lean and source facts stay in the repo's sources.json; this file only holds what the owner has tuned. Every object is closed except topics, trust and boosts entries which use additionalProperties/items on purpose so new topic buckets and trust overrides are a settings action, not a code change (DESIGN-v1.1 section 9 item 2). Key patterns that additionalProperties cannot express (topic id shape, cross references) are checked by validate.js's checkIntegrity, mirroring contract/validate.py's two-phase approach.

profile_version.description: S10: this profile's own version number, one higher every save. The version history keeps every past value, append only.

topics.description: Ranking engine input (DESIGN section 4): per bucket affinity weight and recency half-life. Keyed by topic id, open set so adding a bucket needs no code change. must_know's affinity is zeroed by convention (OWNER-BRIEF derived); its floor comes from floor_slots, not affinity.

trust.description: R10: trust is device owned, keyed by source id (sources.json owns the id, lean is repo owned). A multiplier; a source with no entry here ranks at the ranker's default of 1.0.

boosts.description: Flat boosts (DESIGN section 4): a capped additive term the ranker applies when a story matches.

passes.description: S13 post-pass settings (app/static/js/passes.js), optional: an absent object or field takes the default. Design-set defaults: lean quota at most 60% of any 10 cards from one lean bucket (DESIGN-v1 section 6, R29); exploration slots at positions 4, 14, 24 (DESIGN-v1 section 6). Chosen where the design is silent: one other-side link per page. The must-know floor is topics.must_know.floor_slots.

standing_stories.description: S28 standing stories (R2), optional: an absent field takes the defaults in app/static/js/standing.js (Israel and Gaza, and Sudan, from OWNER-BRIEF); an empty list turns them all off. Owner only: the S19 AI gate reserves every standing_stories path. The list order is the owner's priority when two floors compete for one place. A story qualifies when a headline holds one of `keywords` as a whole word or phrase and, if `tags` is set, carries one of those pool topic tags (with no keywords, a tag alone qualifies). `buckets` name the story's own sources (sources.json buckets), the ones the silence alarm checks for health. The floor keeps at least floor_slots qualifying cards in Today's first floor_within places; the silence alarm shows a notice on Today when the newest qualifying story is older than silence_hours (0 turns the alarm off).

live_overrides.description: S33 Live tab overrides (R22), optional: an absent field takes app/static/js/live.js's LIVE_OVERRIDES_DEFAULTS (nothing pinned or blocked). Owner only: the S19 AI gate reserves this whole path, the same as standing_stories and trust. pinned_event_id keeps one event live regardless of its own live/hold_state, as long as the pool still emits it; blocked_event_ids and blocked_labels keep an event off the tab for good, by id and by a later re-detected event of the same label.

display.description: U1/U2 display settings, optional: an absent object or field takes the default. summaries: "all" shows a summary under every story, "top" only under the lead stories. Default "all".

seen_penalty.description: R17: two weighted signals. opened takes the full penalty, shown (on screen 2s+, scrolled past) a smaller incremental one.

utc_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 in UTC, second precision, Z suffix. Matches contract/pool.schema.json's utc_timestamp.

floor_slots.description: Guaranteed slot count at the top of the front page (must_know). Absent or 0 means no floor.
